notes: Closed vocabularies referenced by the schemas and loader. reviewStatuses, criterionKinds and preferenceOrigins are transcribed directly from Find_Your_Class_Product_Architecture_v1.md (sections 19, 10.1 and 10.6). operationVocabulary and restrictionTypes are a first proposal implementing section 10.3/10.5's requirement for a closed, validated vocabulary (the docs give examples, not a final enumerated list) -- pending confirmation before any archetype/option delta uses an operation not listed here.
fantasyTags is transcribed from section 7.1's initial vocabulary; it is explicitly non-exhaustive there and may grow.

restrictionTypes extended with the ten contextual-gate categories from Find_Your_Class_Criteria_Audit_and_Compass_Calibration_v1.md section 5 (kept as restriction TYPES, reusing the existing rulesRestrictions mechanism, rather than inventing a second parallel gate structure). conductCodePresence/conductMechanicalLossRisk/alignmentRuleKind/deityChoiceProvenance are transcribed from section 4. affinityFamilies and their initial vocabularies are transcribed from section 6.

gateKinds added 2026-09-15 (matcher-contract correction): a compatibilityGate's `type` (from restrictionTypes) categorizes WHAT it's about; `kind` categorizes HOW it affects eligibility. compatibility = an external player/campaign choice can make the profile unavailable, stays needs-confirmation until answered. commitment = a restriction automatically accepted by choosing the archetype -- always eligible, but visibly disclosed, never awaits confirmation. soft = the pre-existing warn-only gates (level/source timing notes); unchanged behaviour, renamed for a consistent closed vocabulary alongside the other two. Replaces the earlier hard:boolean field entirely.

fitBands gained "provisional" 2026-09-15: when the best-overall candidate's fit is below 0.58, it is presented as provisional (visible, but explicitly low-confidence and paired with a next question) instead of worth-considering.
